title: IDD Live Status Digest Payload
description: Structured live-status payload used to render idd-live-status comments.

phase.description: Current IDD phase represented by the digest.

claim.description: Claim identity or status reference for the current work.

branch.description: Implementation or coordination branch associated with the digest.

lastChecked.description: UTC time at which the represented state was last checked.

openBlockers.description: Current blocker summary as free-form text supplied by the caller.

nextAction.description: Next intended action in the IDD workflow.

authoritativeBy.description: Comment, commit, merge, or other evidence that authoritatively supports the digest.
